explanation: The name of God's chosen people, who in the book of Hosea represent the nation that has turned away from God and followed idols.
False gods or objects that people worship instead of the true God, which is strongly condemned in the Bible.
An action, thought, or attitude that goes against God's will and laws, leading to spiritual separation from Him.
The consequences or sufferings that arise as a result of sin and disobedience toward God.
The act of turning away from sin and returning to God with sorrow and renewed faith.
God's grace and love shown to people, even when they do not deserve it.
The principle of acting in accordance with God's will and moral standards, being just and upright in His sight.
